Clinical AI lives or dies at the PHI boundary. XERJ is a self-hosted data plane that holds logs, embeddings, and agent memory inside a hospital VPC or a pharma research enclave — drop-in for existing Elasticsearch clients, auditable per query, HIPAA-BAA-ready on Enterprise tier.
